name: 185. Embedding params outside the OpenAI schema stay off OpenAI-compatible wires (openai-compat-embedding-params)
description: task_type / title / auto_truncate are first-class embedding params (Gemini, Vertex), but the shared OpenAI converter used to copy them onto the wire for every OpenAI-compatible provider. Strict providers such as Mistral reject unknown keys with 422 "Extra inputs are not permitted". Only encoding_format and dimensions are OpenAI fields, so only those are forwarded.

item.name: 185.1 mistral/mistral-embed - task_type, title and auto_truncate are not forwarded
